# hyperping_integrations (Data Source)

Fetches the list of all Hyperping integrations via MCP.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `ids` (List of String) List of integration UUIDs.
- `integrations` (Attributes List) List of integrations. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--integrations))

<a id="nestedatt--integrations"></a>
### Nested Schema for `integrations`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) The time the integration was created.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the integration is enabled.
- `id` (String) The unique identifier (UUID) of the integration.
- `last_test_at` (String) The last time the integration was tested.
- `name` (String) The name of the integration.
- `type` (String) The type of the integration (email, slack, webhook, pagerduty).
